'''Basil Elton''' is an [[ally]].  He first appears in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at the [[North Point Lighthouse]].

==Card info==
*+1 [[Fight]]
*+1 [[Will]]

Discard to cancel the [[Ancient One]]'s entire attack for one turn.

==Mythos Source==

Basil Elton is the keeper of North Point Lighthouse in [[Kingsport]], and appears in ''The White Ship'' (1919), written by H.P. Lovecraft. He joins the bearded captain of [[The White Ship]] in sailing [[the Dreamlands]].
